title: Mask Adoption Dynamics under Social Influence, Policy, and Supply Constraints
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population over time as a function of peer influence, risk perception, policies, enforcement, messaging, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among peers and update their own propensity to wear masks via social contagion and normative pressure.

interactions.name: household_norm_transmission
interactions.description: Household members influence each other’s risk perception and mask-use norms, sharing mask inventory when needed.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities and locations enforce mask mandates; individuals may face denial of entry or fines if noncompliant.

interactions.name: mandate_at_entry
interactions.description: Locations require masks for entry based on policy; individuals decide to comply, acquire a mask, or avoid the location.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to price, budget constraints, and stock availability.

interactions.name: public_health_messaging
interactions.description: Policy authorities and media sources broadcast messages affecting risk perception and trust; misinformation can reduce adoption.

interactions.name: supply_chain_restock
interactions.description: Retailers restock masks from upstream supply, determining availability and potential stockouts.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population wearing a mask on a given day; tracked as a time series.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_location_type
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rates observed within different location types (work, retail, transport, etc.).

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption first reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: time_to_80_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption first reaches 80% of the population.

metrics.name: average_mask_use_days_per_person
metrics.description: Mean number of days individuals wore masks during the simulation window.

metrics.name: stockout_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of days retailers experience zero stock, averaged across retailers and time.

metrics.name: enforcement_incidents_rate
metrics.description: Number of noncompliance incidents per 1,000 person-days.

metrics.name: inequality_index_of_adoption
metrics.description: Gini-like index of mask adoption across income groups or neighborhoods.

metrics.name: MAE_vs_observed_adoption
metrics.description: Mean absolute error between simulated and observed adoption time series (if ground truth is provided).

validation_criteria.name: convergence_stability
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change is less than 1 percentage point over the last 7 days of the run (indicates stabilization).

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity_check
validation_criteria.description: Under scenario tests, higher mandate_level or enforcement_probability should not decrease adoption relative to lower levels, all else equal.

validation_criteria.name: nonnegative_stock_constraint
validation_criteria.description: Retailer stock levels never drop below zero; stockouts are recorded but negative inventory is disallowed.

validation_criteria.name: budget_feasibility
validation_criteria.description: Persons' expenditures on masks do not exceed available budgets; negative budgets are disallowed.

validation_criteria.name: risk_response_sanity
validation_criteria.description: In counterfactual tests where exogenous_risk_series increases, population adoption should weakly increase compared to baseline.

validation_criteria.name: fit_threshold_if_data
validation_criteria.description: If observed adoption data are supplied, MAE_vs_observed_adoption < 0.05 (5 percentage points) over the evaluation window.
